articles.title: The 59-Second Film That Refuses to Die: New Bigfoot Doc Promises Answers
articles.summary: A new documentary, 'Capturing Bigfoot,' hits theaters October 20 — National Bigfoot Day. It explores the famous 1967 Patterson-Gimlin film and claims to feature never-before-seen footage that could finally settle the debate.

articles.title: The Truth Is Still Out There: 'The X-Files' Turns 33
articles.summary: On September 10, 1993, 'The X-Files' premiered on Fox and changed sci-fi TV forever. The show about two FBI agents — one believer, one skeptic — made 'Trust no one' a cultural catchphrase and launched careers.

articles.title: Apple's Big iPhone Event Had One Glaring Omission: The iPhone 18
articles.summary: Apple announced the foldable iPhone Duo and the iPhone 18 Pro at its annual event — but no standard iPhone 18. It's the first time since 2019 that Apple hasn't launched its regular and Pro models together. The iPhone 18 may arrive next spring.
